verdict.rationale: a-Shell's first-party README documents a `config` command that changes the font, font size, background color, text color, and cursor color and shape, with per-window appearance. `config -p` makes the current window's settings permanent for all future windows, covering every element of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the README, and in-depth docs on config options (e.g. available fonts or color formats).
